descriptionChirho: The proper name Asaiah (meaning 'Yahweh has made'), referring to several individuals in the Old Testament: a servant of King Josiah sent to inquire of the prophetess Huldah (2 Kgs 22:12,14, 2 Chr 34:20), a Simeonite leader (1 Chr 4:36), a Merarite Levite involved in transporting the ark (1 Chr 6:15[Heb 6:30], 15:6,11), and a Shilonite settler in Jerusalem (1 Chr 9:5). Multilingual evidence: eng 'Asayah/Asaiah/and Asayah,' spa 'Asaya/Asayas,' hin 'asaayaah,' arb 'asaayaa,' kor 'asaya,' swa 'Asaya.' The conjunction-prefixed form is syntactic coordination, not a different referent.
